description: List the composable iDosGames modules in the catalog. Each entry has id, name, type (template = a complete ready-to-run game to start FROM, e.g. voxelcraft; feature = a capability to add on top), engine, genre, a short summary, what it 'provides' (its features), tags, preview media, a live demo url, and its dependency count. Read 'provides' to reuse a ready module instead of building the feature from scratch, then get_module to pull its source. Entries may also carry 'sharedUi' ({provides, requires, drawsOwn}: shared chrome roles currency-bar | wallet | status | account | menu | modes — the project's base (sign-in + the lobby, see get_host_scaffold) provides currency-bar, wallet, account, menu and modes, and a game hides its own copies automatically) and 'inBase' (true: a system installed with the base in every new project — only profile, inventory, invite, friends and quests; its screen is a tab of the lobby; every other system is added only when the app needs it) and 'uses' (a game's modules: install them together with the game) and 'events' ({emits: [{topic, when, payload}], listens: [{topic, why}]}). To react to another module's event, copy its payload descriptor into your own defineTopic(topic, shape(payload)) — never import another module.
name: list_modules
title: List game modules
